name: issue_dependency_check
title: Check Issue dependency
description: Check the arguments for issue_dependency_write against the pecot rules before writing: the direction, wait kind and reason, a self reference or cycle, whether the blocked-by is already there, and the column the waiting Issue should move to after the change. Reads and writes nothing on GitHub; pass the results of the official reads in reads.

method.description: Same as the method of issue_dependency_write

owner.description: Owner of the repository of the waiting Issue

repo.description: Name of the repository of the waiting Issue

type.description: Same as the type of issue_dependency_write; pecot writes only blocked_by

related_owner.description: Owner of the repository of the prerequisite Issue (defaults to owner)

related_repo.description: Name of the repository of the prerequisite Issue (defaults to repo)

wait.description: With add only: stack (build on its branch; the default) or merge (wait until it is merged)

reason.description: With add and wait merge only: why it waits for the merge, in one line

project.description: Name of the project config under .pecot/config/projects (without .json). Without it, the config that includes the target repository; when several do, the active one among them

reads.description: Results of the official GitHub MCP reads the check needs

issues.description: Results of issue_read with method get (the structuredContent, { issue: ... }): the parent, prerequisites and, with update, the target

blocked_by.description: Results of issue_dependency_read with method get_blocked_by: the waiting Issue, and for add, the prerequisite and the Issues it waits for, until the chain ends

issue.description: The Issue whose blocked-by was read (owner/repo/N)

result.description: Result of issue_dependency_read with method get_blocked_by

project_items.description: Results of projects_list with method list_project_items (every page): the cards of the target, the parent and the prerequisites

project_fields.description: Result of projects_list with method list_project_fields

pull_requests.description: Results of pull_request_read with method get: each open pull request that closes a prerequisite (closed_by_pull_requests of issue_read), and those its base branch stacks on; they decide whether the Issue can stack

issue.description: Issue the problem belongs to: a batch key or owner/repo/N (omitted when the check covers one target)

field.description: Name of the argument that breaks the rule (title, body, issue_fields.<name>, blocked_by.<i>, ...)

code.description: Kind of the problem (missing-section, extra-heading, cycle, ...)

message.description: What is wrong and how to fix it, with the expected value when there is one

candidates.description: Values that would be accepted (omitted when there is no fixed set)

problems.description: Rules the arguments break; when empty, the arguments can be passed to the write tool as they are

expected_status.description: Column (pecot-status) the waiting Issue should be moved to after the change, by its option name on the board (omitted when it stays)

body.description: Body of the waiting Issue with the line of the prerequisite added to or removed from the Waits for merge section; write it with issue_check (method update) and issue_write (method update). Omitted when the body stays

detail.description: Full failure text: the error message and the guidance lines that follow it (failure only)

log.description: Raw output of a child process (failure only; omitted when not captured)

warnings.description: Warning messages; continuation lines of a message are indented by two spaces (omitted when there is none)
